messages:
Alyssa: quick question — during shard handoff when residency moves between shards, do we have any invariant to avoid brief stale KV reads?
Mike: not strictly. we rely on lease invalidation + eviction; micro-window possible if request races invalidation.
Jamal: sketch the race?
Alyssa: t0 write on shard-A, lease revoked, shard-B takes ownership but has older prefix cache. read to B before it fetches latest -> stale.
Tara: we've tried short lease grace + synchronous refresh on takeover but it increases takeover latency.
Oliver: what's required: RAWR for writes routed to same tenant?
Alyssa: product wants RAWR for dedicated/pinned tenants; shared pools prefer but can be weaker.
Mike: options:
- handshake: old shard sends compact changelog to new (costly)
- versioned prefix metadata (seqno) gating reads
- read-path validation: fetch small digest to compare
Jamal: prefer metadata+digest. we already store checkpoint seq in metadata.
Tara: digest needs authoritative source. use index service to get tenant's last_seq and block until local prefix.seq >= last_seq.
Oliver: blocks first reads — acceptable? we can background prefetch and have read fall back to fetch-if-stale.
Alyssa: strawman flow: 1) transfer start 2) old shard annotates with last_seq ls 3) new shard sets ownership and checks local prefix.seq >= ls 4a) if true fast path 4b) else sync small fetch then serve; emit metric handoff_slow_path
Mike: should be rare but spikes during rebalances.
Jamal: avoid thundering herd: add jitter + cooperative background prefetch.
Tara: evicted prefixes: mark recently-evicted hint to prefetch on takeover.
Oliver: add bounded timeout (e.g., 200ms) for sync fetch; beyond that fall back to stale-read-with-warning to avoid outage.
Alyssa: fallback opt-in per tenant: dedicated -> strict RAWR; shared -> may accept stale with telemetry.
Mike: proto:
```
TRANSFER_REQ { tenant_id, transfer_id, last_seq }
TRANSFER_ACK { transfer_id, accepted_at, prefetch_status }
```
Jamal: persist transfer_id to prevent duplicate takeovers.
Tara: ops: surface metrics kv.handoff.slow_path.count, kv.handoff.prefetch.throttled, handoff_failures; add rollout knob.
Oliver: cluster-test: write-heavy tenant, force rebalance, assert RAWR for dedicated.
Alyssa: test plan two-node cluster etc.
Mike: question: acceptable latency increase from sync fetch? set SLOs.
Jamal: alternative: pre-subscribe invalidation stream before takeover — lower latency but more orchestration.
Alyssa: tradeoffs summarized.
Tara: ops prefer handshake+sync fetch+metrics to start.
Oliver: agree. action items: Alyssa RFC + diagrams; Mike metrics + canary scripts; Jamal controller transfer_id; Tara rollout flags; schedule 30m sync.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary apply 2026-04-02T15:00Z :rocket:
Alyssa: documenting RFC draft now. :thumbsup:
